# garage_bucket (Resource)

Manages a Garage S3 bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "garage_bucket" "website" {
  global_alias   = "my-website"
  website_access = true
  index_document = "index.html"
  error_document = "error.html"
  max_size       = 5368709120  # 5 GiB
  max_objects    = 100000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `global_alias` (String) Global alias for the bucket. Must be a valid S3 bucket name.

### Optional

- `error_document` (String) Error document for website access.
- `index_document` (String) Index document for website access.
- `max_objects` (Number) Maximum number of objects in the bucket. Null means unlimited.
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum total size of objects in the bucket (bytes). Null means unlimited.
- `website_access` (Boolean) Whether website access is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) Total size of objects in the bucket (bytes).
- `created` (String) Bucket creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Bucket identifier.
- `objects` (Number) Number of objects in the bucket.
- `unfinished_multipart_upload_bytes` (Number) Total bytes in unfinished multipart uploads.
- `unfinished_multipart_upload_parts` (Number) Number of parts in unfinished multipart uploads.
- `unfinished_multipart_uploads` (Number) Number of unfinished multipart uploads.
- `unfinished_uploads` (Number) Number of unfinished uploads.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import garage_bucket.website <bucket-id>
```
